question: Does a constant-free procedure (Otsu on contact-only rows) give a stall threshold that reproduces the decisions of the hand-set 3 mm rule and keeps its mode-test quality?

definition.window: 24 steps (one plan length), net hand displacement d24 = |p_t - p_(t-24)| as recorded by the server (verifier_P[:,10])
definition.contact_feature: g = mean over the same 24 steps of |C8D[0:3] - C8D[0:3] at episode step 0| (tactile force summary, baseline = episode start)
definition.contact_threshold: scale_rule_20261117 rule() (Otsu, linear vs log picked by eta) on g over all pre-success refresh rows
definition.stall_threshold: the same rule() on d24 over rows with g > contact_threshold
definition.free_constants: none (M = 2 and the 24-step window are unchanged)

data.dev: unify0_20261116 NORULE, seeds 20260921-23, 8 cohorts each (thresholds are fitted here)
data.holdout: qdata_20261116 arms Q200_OLD Q400_OLD Q200_NV Q400_NV QFULL_NV, seed 20260921
data.agreement: Q400B seeds 21 (evq_20261117), 22-23 (b2_20261117): pre-success refresh rows, thresholds from dev
data.mode_test: same episodes and episode-level definition as resoff3_20261119 (first stall before 90 deg rotation; flip = wrong mode), per-step d24 from ee_pos and per-step 24-step mean of g; arms Q400B (on) and Q400B0 (off)

predictions.S2: holdout stall_threshold within +-30% of dev and same scale pick (stall threshold)
predictions.S3: row-level stall flag agreement new vs old (d24 < 3 mm) >= 0.95 on Q400B
predictions.S4: on arm: AUROC_new >= AUROC_old - 0.02, FPR_new <= FPR_old + 0.03, TPR_new >= TPR_old - 0.05
predictions.S5: FPR_off - FPR_on >= 0.30 under the new criterion

verdict.SAME_DECISIONS: S1-S5 all true: adopt the procedure, existing simulation results stand without rerun
verdict.ADOPTABLE_NEEDS_RERUN: S1, S2, S4, S5 true and S3 false: procedure is sound but decisions differ; closed-loop 3-seed rerun needs user approval
verdict.NOT_ADOPTED: otherwise: recorded as is, no rerun of this gate without changes and user approval

expectation: S1 uncertain (about even odds); if S1 holds the rest should follow
also_reported_exploratory: contact threshold and share of contact rows
agreement of the M=2 consecutive flag
rule() on all rows (no contact condition) for reference
